== Ingredients ==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] rib-eye steak, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thinly across the grain on a bias
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]
* ½ each red and green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 1 tbsp minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 Thai bird [[Cookbook:Chiles|chili]], finely minced

== Procedure ==
#Season beef liberally with salt and black pepper. Set aside.
#Preheat a large stainless steel or cast iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]], or a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]], over medium high heat. Add peanut oil and seasoned beef and cook, tossing often, until meat is browned and slightly charred on both sides. Remove and keep warm.
#Toss remaining ingredients together and place into the wok. Cook, tossing often, until vegetables are slightly browned around edges.
#Add steak and heat through. Serve warm with soy sauce on the side.
